## Why This Process Is Required

Lead Hub launched on 2026-09-15 and the LeadLab Director accepted the application. The project now needs a final outcome record, a controlled operations handoff, a schedule and cost position, and lessons proposed for review. Several operational controls remain active, so closure must distinguish accepted launch completion from unresolved follow-on work.

ACT-73 (Prepare and record the Lead Hub project closure and operations handoff package) is the direct trigger for this review.

## Tailoring Factors

| Factor | Project evidence | Tailoring effect |
|---|---|---|
| Live production outcome | The launch is PM-confirmed, and Director acceptance is recorded | Include acceptance and value evidence, but do not infer completion of separate operational controls |
| Operational exposure | Gate 1 evidence, activity logging, bot-abuse controls, backup, patching, availability, and related decisions remain open | Use a residual-control register view and preserve each existing state and owner |
| Transition ownership | Dennis Arquillano is recorded as interim IT operator; technical owner and primary developer remain unconfirmed | Show current owners and gaps; do not assign new ownership in this run |
| Schedule | The actual launch is recorded; no approved schedule baseline exists | Record actual date, proposed post-launch review, and no-baseline limits |
| Cost | Software licence cost is $0 and domain cost is up to $25 per year; labor, infrastructure, support, and actuals are not baselined | Record known cost position without claiming a complete budget or final actuals |
| Historical closure evidence | The existing closure report describes the older SharePoint portal | Treat it as historical evidence only; create a current Lead Hub closure record only after approval |
| Knowledge capture | The lessons-learned register is empty | Prepare proposed lessons; leave acceptance and application to the PM |

## Minimum Output

1. Record the accepted Lead Hub outcome and the 2026-09-15 production launch.
2. Identify completed deliverables and acceptance evidence without claiming unperformed verification.
3. Document remaining operational work, current owners, ownership gaps, and handoff conditions.
4. Record the final known schedule and cost position, including material limits.
5. Prepare proposed lessons and a current closure or handoff carrier without duplicating existing sources.
6. Present one clear PM decision on whether to close the project with residual operational controls retained as active follow-on work.

## Trigger And Review Point

The run is triggered by the PM direction recorded on 2026-09-21 and ACT-73. The review point is the Stage 04 approval checkpoint in this run. The proposed closure timing is later on 2026-09-21, subject to PM decision and operational-handoff acceptance.

## Authority Boundary

This run may prepare the closure package, proposed handoff, proposed lessons, and approval request through Stage 04. It may not close the project or any remaining action, issue, risk, dependency, or lesson; assign an owner; accept a deliverable; change a baseline; edit external source documents; or enter Stage 05 without later explicit PM direction.

## Candidate Artifact Scope

The PM-09 candidates are filtered in Stage 02. The run uses existing acceptance, schedule, cost, RAID, and operational evidence; proposes one current closure and handoff carrier; updates the existing lessons register only after PM approval; and defers a full deployment and runtime operations plan until target-environment evidence is available.
